questions.question: Who is the director of the series ' House of Cards ' produced by Netflix ?
questions.sql: SELECT d.name FROM director d JOIN directed_by db ON d.did = db.did JOIN tv_series t ON db.msid = t.sid JOIN made_by mb ON t.sid = mb.msid JOIN company c ON mb.pid IN (SELECT pid FROM producer) WHERE t.title = 'House of Cards' AND c.name = 'Netflix';
